name: Deputy COO Control Tower
subtitle: Akij Group — Multi-Plant Production & Maintenance Dashboard
description: 15-plant live dashboard with OEE, NPT, MTBF/MTTR, MOH Budget vs Today, AI analysis and Gmail reporting

mssql_dwh.note: Credentials via env MSSQL_* — never commit password. DWH firewalled: whitelist Vercel 76.76.19.0/24,76.223.126.0/24 and GitHub Actions meta CIDRs for cloud live, or use self-hosted runner

moh.budget: mes.tblMOHBudget / mes.tblProductionBudget / dbo.MOHBudget (fallback 108% of 6M avg if no budget table)

endpoints.data: GET /api/data?plant=<key> — full DATA or single plant, no-store, live from index.html or DWH
endpoints.live: GET /api/live?date=YYYY-MM-DD — today's OEE/MOH/NPT per plant (DWH live, cached 2min, fallback to Gist)
endpoints.pushLive: POST /api/push-live — office push to Vercel, header x-push-secret, updates /tmp + Gist akij-live.json
endpoints.emails: GET/POST /api/emails — max 5, persisted to /tmp/dashboard-config.json (ephemeral on Vercel) + local dashboard-config.json
endpoints.send: POST /api/send — Gmail via OAuth, body {to, subject, html}
endpoints.analyze: POST /api/analyze — DeepSeek if DEEPSEEK_API_KEY else offline built-in

live.initialFetch: GET /api/data on DOMContentLoaded, replaces embedded __DATA_JSON__, badge ● LIVE MCP DATA
live.incremental: GET /api/live every 5 min (visible tab) + manual ↻ Refresh Live button, merges today into DATA.plants[PLANT].daily/mohDaily

push.vercelReads: api/live checks memory → /tmp → Gist (30min TTL) → DWH

rebuild.githubActions: .github/workflows/rebuild.yml (06:30 Dhaka, ubuntu-latest, graceful skip if DWH unreachable)
rebuild.setupScript: setup-selfhosted-runner.ps1 — registers runner, keep dashboard-server-local.js as service via nssm

features.extraPanel: MOH Budget vs Actual — Today & MTD (Today Actual vs Daily Budget, MTD Actual vs MTD Budget, Monthly Budget, Remaining, daily+cumulative chart)
features.ai: Built-in analyst engine + DeepSeek fallback, range 1-400 days
features.email: Max 5 recipients, Save Addresses, Send Report via Gmail (OAuth refresh via GOOGLE_* env)

security.note: Do not commit MSSQL_PASSWORD, GH token, or Gmail refresh token. Use Vercel encrypted env and GitHub Actions secrets. Gist f2ce2cd06bb735a2aa5db36532d1e0e6 is secret (unlisted).
